project.name: The Manhattan Project: The Secret Race to Build the Atomic Bomb
project.visual_rule: Use distinct, authentic archival photographs and primary-source documents for every beat. Never substitute repeated vector diagrams or generated fake archival photographs. Use original schematic graphics only as brief overlays/inserts, never as the main visual for a photo beat.
